title: BEGINNER LINE DANCE  - ELECTRIC SLIDE - TUTORIAL!

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down each line dance step sequentially, offering verbal guidance alongside continuous physical demonstration from the back view. She encourages learners at regular intervals and provides tips on weight distribution and direction changes.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to the Electric Slide tutorial for beginners.
Breaking down the right grapevines step by step.
Breaking down the left grapevine step by step.
Breaking down the backward walk steps.
Breaking down the forward and backward rock step.
Breaking down the final step and quarter turn.
Dancing through all four walls to practice.

common_mistakes: struggling with the turn when facing a different wall

steps_taught.name: Grapevine Right
steps_taught.description: Step right, cross left behind, step right, touch left.

steps_taught.name: Grapevine Left
steps_taught.description: Step left, cross right behind, step left, touch right.

steps_taught.name: Back Walks
steps_taught.description: Walk back right, left, right, touch left.

steps_taught.name: Rock Steps
steps_taught.description: Rock forward left, touch right, rock back right, touch left.

steps_taught.name: Step Scuff Turn
steps_taught.description: Step forward and scuff right foot while making a quarter turn.

quotes.text: This is pretty much as easy as it gets when it comes to line dancing.
Go ahead and rewind that video and do it until you're caught up.
Some of my line dance instructor friends call it second wall amnesia.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates grapevine right facing away from camera.
Teacher demonstrates grapevine left facing away from camera.

extraction.distinctive_method: Using progressive wall turns and repeating full sequences multiple times from the back view to build muscle memory.
